_doc: Capstone treatment of the Aterio data-center census — the house rules for any headline number taken from it.
Decided by Felipe on 2026-11-09 (answers to the six-question review of the export). Hand-edit; read by _wiki/_tools/aterio_capstone_view.py.
Change a rule here, rerun the view (or the dc-delay-risk build), and note the change and date in 'history'.

basis.headline: IT-eq
basis.note: Facility power (SELECTED_POWER_CAPACITY_MW) ÷ Aterio's own facility/IT median, measured on the buildings that carry both fields in the export being read (1.15 on the 08-31 export). Comparable with SemiAnalysis, the registry and the chip models. Facility GW is still shown for power and grid questions.

date_note: Aterio's activation date as published (Aterio's own estimate in ~95% of buildings that carry both); no Capstone delay haircut on top.

exclude.note: A campus rated Low likelihood whose buildings name no end user is dropped in every stage (it removes low-likelihood construction and delayed sites with no tenant; low-likelihood announced sites are already out under the High-only rule). A building without a campus ID is its own campus.

tenant_note: Outside the low-likelihood rule, a named end user is not required.
registry_role: The public-source registry (dc-delay-risk) stays independent; Aterio is the cross-check, not the base.

history.change: first version: IT-eq headline; construction + delayed + announced High; Aterio's published activation date; drop Low-likelihood campuses with no tenant; no tenant requirement otherwise; registry independent.

ratio kept at the median (÷1.15) after the double-check showed 417 of 1,025 rows at exactly 1.000; the MW-weighted (÷1.17) and without-1.000 (÷1.27) variants stay on the page as the 169-186 GW band. Decided by Felipe.
